findings.detail: Each role matches its receipt native digest, report fingerprint and capture tool. Before/after inventory, inputs and generator must match, with explicit integrity flags and empty failures. Both captured native inventories must bind both clock source hashes listed among the qualifier inputs. The qualifier generator and both receipt/report fingerprints must be exact listed inputs. Existing callers verify the actual file fingerprints and retain their source/manifests/chronology checks.

Exact record schema; valid role and captured session; positive safe canonical trace identifier; unique role/session/trace; finite float64 bits agreeing exactly with seconds and integer milliseconds; canonical UTC timestamp inside that role receipt interval; receipt boundary strings exact. Both roles must exist for each emitted trace pair and every captured session must be represented. The validators do not mutate evidence.

Four ordered forms are fixed. Captures and terminal inspections match retained shape array lengths; their counters define the exact ordered point register for both roles. Coverage reproduces each point node/delta count under the precise policy with zero unattributed differences. Unique paired records do not independently establish that no entire trace pair was omitted; exact other bodies, exhaustive graph traversal, role-bound graph origins, chains and tickets remain guarantees of the fingerprinted qualifier. This limitation is explicitly documented, with no invented trace-count formula.
